scenes.title: Sela Thorn on pier four
scenes.summary: The party looks for a boat and meets Sela Thorn, a tide-reader who will row them out for two silver, but never at night. She says Saltmere flooded the night the bell first rang forty years ago, with warm water. She'll be at pier four at first light tomorrow.

scenes.title: The flooded Saltmere Mine
scenes.place: Saltmere Mine, cliff path above Gullwick
scenes.summary: The mine breathes warm air that smells of church candle wax. The tunnel is flooded with warm black water and floating hymn-book pages. One page is annotated in pencil "M. Brand", which Teo recognizes as his sister Mira's handwriting. Dana and Priya guess the harbor-master Maren is in the cult.

scenes.title: Midnight at the drowned chapel
scenes.place: Shore below the old chapel ruins
scenes.summary: Fishermen warn of the Kelp Mother, who pulls children down by the ankles. At midnight the bell rings twelve times under water, the humming is much louder, and pale shapes stand in rows on the chapel floor. The GM notes the choir clock is at three of six. The party flees.

scenes.title: Planning at the Tarred Gull
scenes.place: The Tarred Gull, tavern by the docks
scenes.summary: The party plans to have Sela row them out at first light tomorrow and dive to the chapel at low tide, following Mira's hymn-book trail. Innkeeper Bram feeds them and says Maren lost a brother to the bay. The party takes a long rest.
